description: Edit a path's anchor points, as the Add Anchor Point, Delete Anchor Point, Convert Point and Direct Selection tools do: add a point (splitting a segment in half without changing its shape, or at a position), delete one, move a point or its direction handles, convert it between smooth and corner, or change a component's path operation. The path is rebuilt under its name; a work path becomes a saved path

handleIn.description: Direction point of the arriving segment, pixels

handleOut.description: Direction point of the leaving segment, pixels

kind.description: convert_point: smooth computes handles from the neighbouring points unless handles are given; corner retracts the handles unless handles are given

path.description: Path name, as in the Paths panel (list_paths)

pathIndex.description: Path index from list_paths, instead of its name

pathOperation.description: set_operation: combine, subtract, intersect or exclude

point.description: Point index in the component. add_point: without x and y, splits the segment after this point; with them, inserts the new point at this index

smooth.description: add_point with x and y: make a smooth point. Default false

x.description: add_point and move_point: anchor position, pixels from the left

y.description: add_point and move_point: anchor position, pixels from the top

name: edit_path_points
title: Edit Path Points
